findings.title: IDOR on GET /api/orders/{id} — any user reads any order
findings.standard: OWASP A01:2025 Broken Access Control; CWE-639
findings.fine_exposure: GDPR Art. 83(5): up to EUR 20M / 4 % of global annual turnover
findings.evidence: handlers/orders.ts:42 runs db.orders.find({ id: req.params.id }) with no owner check; repro: user A retrieves user B's order by id.
findings.impact: Horizontal privilege escalation; full read of every customer's orders.
findings.fix: Scope the query to the caller: find({ id, ownerId: req.user.id }); return 404 on miss.
findings.expected_impact: Closes cross-tenant order access on this endpoint.
findings.anticipated_refutation: 'Requires auth' — an authenticated user is exactly the attacker here.

findings.title: Postgres security group open to 0.0.0.0/0 on 5432
findings.fine_exposure: GDPR Art. 83(4): up to EUR 10M / 2 % of global annual turnover
findings.evidence: infra/network.tf:61 ingress cidr_blocks = ["0.0.0.0/0"] port 5432; db instance publicly_accessible = true (infra/rds.tf:22).
findings.fix: Set publicly_accessible=false; restrict ingress to the app subnet only.
findings.expected_impact: Removes internet exposure of the primary datastore.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy on all HTML responses
findings.evidence: Response headers for GET / (curl -I, 2026-09-16): no Content-Security-Policy; next.config.ts:12 sets only X-Frame-Options.
findings.fix: Add a CSP with default-src 'self' and a nonce for inline scripts in next.config.ts headers().
findings.expected_impact: Blocks the most common XSS exploitation paths at the browser.

findings.title: SECURITY.md names no response time for reports
findings.evidence: SECURITY.md has a contact address but no acknowledgement window or disclosure timeline; see section 'Reporting' (lines 1-20 of the file).
findings.fix: State an acknowledgement SLA (e.g. 3 business days) and a coordinated-disclosure window (90 days).
findings.expected_impact: Reporters know what to expect; CRA Annex I Part II(5) readiness.

controls.evidence: TLS 1.3 only, HSTS preload; secrets in AWS Secrets Manager

coverage.sampled: 12 of 87 endpoints reviewed for authorization; all IaC files reviewed
coverage.limits: no DAST, no cloud-account access; CI logs not inspected

summary.en: Two deal-blocking exposures (cross-tenant order access, internet-reachable database) put the ISO 27001 readiness at 62.5 %; both are small fixes. After remediation the technical controls in scope are at 87 %, with three organisational controls still needing policy evidence.
summary.de: Zwei Deal-Blocker (mandantenübergreifender Bestellzugriff, aus dem Internet erreichbare Datenbank) drücken die ISO-27001-Readiness auf 62.5 %; beide sind kleine Fixes. Nach der Behebung liegen die technischen Controls im Scope bei 87 %, drei organisatorische Controls brauchen noch Richtlinien-Nachweise.
